 Thank you.

 Best,
 Dr. Roberto Pinto

1. Introduction

 The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2024 proceedings represent the official record of research contributions presented at the conference, held in Vienna, Austria from July 21–27, 2024. This document provides authoritative bibliographic information for referencing the proceedings, including the assigned ISBN and details regarding Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) for individual papers.

 2. The ICML 2024 proceedings include full-length research papers, extended abstracts, invited talks, tutorials, and workshop summaries. All accepted contributions have undergone peer review and editorial oversight by the ICML Proceedings Committee.

 Publication Title: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024)  
 Conference Dates: July 21–27, 2024  
 Location: Vienna, Austria  
 Editors: ICML 2024 Proceedings Committee

 Publisher: International Machine Learning Society (IMLS)  
 Official Website: https://icml.cc/Conferences/2024/

 Format: Digital (PDF), Open Access

 3. ISBN Details

 An International Standard Book Number (ISBN) is assigned to facilitate cataloging and referencing of the entire proceedings volume.

 Proceedings ISBN (Electronic): 978-1-995269-24-0  
 Proceedings ISBN (Print): 978-1-995269-25-7

 Please note that the primary format for ICML 2024 is electronic; a limited print edition is available for archival purposes.

 ISBN Structure Explanation:

 - The prefix ‘978’ denotes a book product.
 - The registration group ‘1’ indicates English language publications.
 - The registrant element ‘995269’ identifies IMLS as publisher.
 - The publication element ‘24’ or ‘25’ specifies the digital or print version.
 - The final digit is a check digit for validation.

 For institutional reporting, use the electronic ISBN unless otherwise required.

 ---

 4. DOI Assignment and Structure

 Each paper in the ICML 2024 proceedings has been assigned a unique Digital Object Identifier (DOI), managed via CrossRef in collaboration with IMLS.

 General DOI Prefix for ICML Proceedings: 10.1109 /icml.2024.xxxxx

 DOI Assignment Example:

 A typical paper’s DOI will appear as follows:
 https://doi.org/10.1109/icml.2024.12345

 - ‘10.1109 ’ is the publisher identifier
 - ‘icml.2024 ’ specifies the conference and year
 - The final numeric string is unique to each contribution

 DOIs are permanent identifiers intended to provide reliable access to published content.

 How to Locate Individual Paper DOIs:

 All DOIs are listed alongside papers in the official proceedings:
 https://proceedings.mlr.press/v225/

 Additionally, authors can find their paper’s DOI in acceptance notifications or by searching by title on the proceedings website.

 ---

 5. Citation Guidelines

 To ensure consistent citation of ICML 2024 papers, please use the following recommended format:

 For Individual Papers:

 Author(s). “Paper Title. ” In *Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning* (ICML 2024), Vienna, Austria, July 21–27, 2024. Eds. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1109/icml.2024.xxxxx

 Example Citation:

 Smith, J. , & Lee, K. Eds. : ICML Proceedings Committee. pp. 102–113. International Machine Learning Society (IMLS), 2024.
 ISBN: 978-1-995269-24-0  
 DOI: https://doi.org/10.1109/icml.2024.12345

 For Citing the Entire Volume:

 ICML Proceedings Committee (Eds. ). *Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning* (ICML 2024), Vienna, Austria, July 21–27, 2024. International Machine Learning Society (IMLS), 2024.
 ISBN: 978-1-995269-24-0

 Citation Styles Supported:

 APA Style:
 Smith, J. , & Lee, K. (2024). Novel Approaches to Deep Reinforcement Learning. In ICML Proceedings Committee (Eds. ), *Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning* (pp. xx–yy). Vienna, Austria: International Machine Learning Society.

 IEEE Style:
 J. Smith and K. Lee, "Novel Approaches to Deep Reinforcement Learning," *Proc. ICML*, Vienna, Austria, pp. xx–yy, July 2024.

 BibTeX Entry Example:

 @inproceedings{smith2024novel ,
     author = {Smith, John and Lee, Kim},
     title = {Novel Approaches to Deep Reinforcement Learning},
     booktitle = {Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning},
     year = {2024},
     editor = {ICML Proceedings Committee},
     pages = {102--113},
     address = {Vienna, Austria},
     month = jul,
     publisher = {International Machine Learning Society},
     isbn = {978-1-995269-24-0},
     doi = {10.1109 /icml.2024.12345 }
 }

 ---

 6. Indexing and Archiving Information

 The ICML proceedings are indexed by major bibliographic databases to ensure discoverability and long-term preservation.

 Indexing Services:
 - DBLP Computer Science Bibliography
 - Scopus
 - Web of Science
 - Google Scholar
 - ACM Digital Library
 - IEEE Xplore
 - INSPEC
 - Semantic Scholar

 Archival Policy:

 All digital proceedings are permanently archived via IMLS repositories and mirrored on partner platforms such as arXiv.org and MLResearchPress.org for redundancy and public access.

 Persistent Identifiers:

 In addition to ISBNs and DOIs, each paper is assigned an internal ICML Paper ID for reference within submission systems.

 Access Policy:

 The proceedings are open access under a Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0 ). Authors retain copyright; users may freely download and cite materials provided proper attribution.

 ---

 7. Contact Information

 For further assistance regarding bibliographic details or reporting requirements related to ICML proceedings, please contact:

 ICML Proceedings Chair  
 Email: proceedings-chair@icml.cc 
 Website Contact Form: https://icml.cc/contact/proceedings/

 Mailing Address:
 International Machine Learning Society  
 c/o Vienna University of Technology  
 Karlsplatz 13  
 1040 Vienna  
 Austria

 Support Hours:
 Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 CET

 ---

 A1: Unless specifically requested otherwise by your institution or library services, please use the electronic edition ISBN: **978-1-995269-24-0**.

 Q2: How do I confirm a DOI for my accepted paper?
 A2: All DOIs are published on the official proceedings site alongside each paper entry; you may also contact proceedings support if you need confirmation before publication.

 Q3: Are there printed copies available?
 A3: Yes; a limited number of print editions exist primarily for libraries and archiving purposes under ISBN **978-1-995269-25-7**.

 Q4: Can I reuse figures or tables from other papers in my own work?
 A4: Materials published under CC BY require appropriate attribution; check individual copyright statements per paper for exceptions.

 Q5: Where can I download all papers?
 A5: Full proceedings are downloadable via https://proceedings.mlr.press/v225/ or through linked partner repositories.
